items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: after Clauda arranged some other things for me I began to appear with the band, with John Kirby's Orchestra.

ctx.x: Jenny came to New York with me and we worked at the Onyx Club in the beginning during intermission. And I'd say about a month. And then of course after Clauda arranged some other things for me I began to appear with the band, with John Kirby's Orchestra. And Jenny continued to play intermission. And she was there, well the whole time I was there, but what happened was, I became, after having done 'Loch Lomond' I became very popular and I left the Onyx Club and went out to Hollywood. Jenny didn't want to travel…
